# IDURAR

> IDURAR is a design studio based in Oran, Algeria, specializing in Packaging Design, Logo Design, and Branding / Visual Identity for businesses across Algeria — with dedicated local service in Oran, Alger (Algiers), Sétif, Annaba, Constantine, Tlemcen, Mostaganem, Béjaïa, and Bordj Bou Arréridj. IDURAR takes packaging from concept to production-ready artwork (labels, pouches, boxes, cartons) adapted to industrial and food-packaging standards, and builds logos and brand identity systems (charte graphique) with a brand-marketing focus.

This file follows the llms.txt standard (llmstxt.org) so AI assistants and LLM-based crawlers — including ChatGPT/OpenAI, Claude/Anthropic, Gemini/Google, DeepSeek, Meta AI, and Grok/xAI — can reliably discover, cite, and summarize IDURAR's core services. Content is available in 3 languages: /fr /en /ar. Studio HQ: Oran, Algeria. Contact: Phone / WhatsApp: +213 541 13 37 00.

## Service Area

IDURAR serves clients remotely across all of Algeria, with dedicated local service in: Oran, Alger (Algiers), Sétif, Annaba, Constantine, Tlemcen, Mostaganem, Béjaïa, and Bordj Bou Arréridj. All Packaging Design, Logo Design, and Branding projects can be delivered remotely nationwide from the Oran studio; on-site designer visits are available in these cities and elsewhere in Algeria by arrangement.

## Core Services

- [Packaging Design (Conception de Packaging)](https://idurarweb.com/agence-algerie/conception-packaging-emballage-algerie/): Graphic design for packaging and food packaging for businesses across Algeria (Oran, Alger, Sétif, Annaba, Constantine, Tlemcen, Mostaganem, Béjaïa, Bordj Bou Arréridj, and nationwide) — labels (étiquette), pouches/bags (sachet), boxes (boite), and cartons — from initial concept to production-ready artwork, adapted to industrial packaging standards, with a premium/brand-marketing approach.
- [Logo Design & Branding (Conception de Logo & Branding)](https://idurarweb.com/agence-algerie/conception-logo-algerie/): Logo creation and redesign (refonte), development of a full brand style guide (charte graphique), and visual identity applied across print, web, business cards, and letterhead, for businesses across Algeria (Oran, Alger, Sétif, Annaba, Constantine, Tlemcen, Mostaganem, Béjaïa, Bordj Bou Arréridj, and nationwide).
- [Contact](https://idurarweb.com/agence-algerie/connect/): Request a quote or start a Packaging, Logo, or Branding project. Phone / WhatsApp: +213 541 13 37 00. Address: Oran, Algeria. Online quote/lead form also available.

## Add-on Services

- On-Site Designer Visit (Déplacement du Designer Principal Chez le Client): IDURAR's principal designer can travel to the customer's office/premises anywhere in Algeria — including Oran, Alger, Sétif, Annaba, Constantine, Tlemcen, Mostaganem, Béjaïa, and Bordj Bou Arréridj — to work on-site on Packaging, Logo, or Branding projects. Contact by phone or WhatsApp to arrange a visit.
